title: A new EmDash site gets its mail path through the Tracy relay, or the provision refuses to mark it ready
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (no stand, no database, no listener needed) run: node --test packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/emdash-mail.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/emdash-post-up.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`, and every test line whose name starts with `mail`.
expect: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `fail 0`.
emdash-mail.test.mjs: `an unconfigured site gets phpmail, the sender and the exclusive hook, then a readback` passes.
emdash-post-up.test.mjs: `mail (generic): configured after the token is stored and before ready, PAT off argv` and the same line for `mail (business)` pass.
emdash-post-up.test.mjs: `mail (generic): no shim, no relay variables, another label or a failed exec FAILS before the helper` and the same line for `mail (business)` pass.

emdash-post-up.test.mjs: `mail (demo through provision.sh): a framed demo is configured, and one without the shim still FAILS` and `mail (demo through deploy-quickstart.sh): no mail step on that road, and it says the demo mails nobody` pass.
evidence: Issue #803 (source-confirmed, runtime-unverified): no provision step selected a mail provider. Before the fix the ten `mail (generic|business)` cases of emdash-post-up.test.mjs fail and emdash-mail.test.mjs cannot load its helper.
fence: platform_post_up returns nonzero unless the running container shows the sendmail shim and relay variables and configure-mail.mjs exits 0; the helper adds only what is missing, reads it back, and refuses any answer it cannot read. Fake site and fake Docker: not a proof that a real site delivered a message.
